text:
Priya: FYI we hit a weird regression during qbringup for qx2b-int4 when running multilingual longform prompts (>800 tokens). Output truncates mid-sentence and repeats a short suffix.
Jorge: can you paste an example?
Priya: pasted a minimized repro in the bucket: s3://redwood-tests/multilang-repro/1912345678.jsonl. example input: 
```
# mixed Hindi + Arabic + emoji + code block
कृपया इस निबंध का सार लिखें और नीचे पायथन कोड का संक्षेप दें:
def fib(n):
    if n<2:
        return n
    a,b=0,1
    for _ in range(n):
        a,b=b,a+b
    return b

وَهذا نص عربي لتمديد السياق وإدخال حالة ثنائية الاتجاه. 😀😀😀
```
observed qx2b-int4: truncation at ~842 tokens + repeating "\nThis is a short suffix...This is a short suffix..."
expected: full summary and single-pass code explanation.
Lena: what quant parms?
Priya: `--bits 4 --group-size 256 --per-channel` on kernel v2, kv-cache enabled with default sharding. Ran on dedicated g5x-medium.
Abe: seems related to longctx + mixed script combining BiDi + emoji. Could be tokenization causing repeated boundary tokens. Suggests: 1) create a mixed-script stress suite, 2) dedupe with unicode normalization NFC + remove ZWJ/ZWNJ, 3) golden-label 300 items covering bidi/code/emoji combos, 4) run kernel-level tracing to capture cache slot evictions.
Jorge: I'll kick off dedupe script with these settings. command:
```bash
python tools/dedupe.py --input s3://redwood-tests/multilang-repro/*.jsonl \
  --norm NFC --drop-zwj --shingle 7 --hash cityhash --thresh 8 \
  --out s3://redwood-curation/multilang-stress/1912345678-dedup.jsonl
```
LabelerBot: current annotator pool: 12 available, prioritization tag #multilang-stress #golden. Est ETA for 300 golden items: ~2 business days.
Priya: I'll assemble the stress suite: 2k candidates -> 300 golden -> 50 micro-gold for quick canary. Will also run runs with kv-cache disabled to compare.
Lena: add synthetic variants that shuffle sentence order and insert escaped unicode sequences. Use scripts/synth_unicode_variants.py --langs hi,ar,he --n 3 --max-tokens 1200
Abe: for kernel tracing I'll instrument the runtime to log kv-cache insert/delete and kernel fallback events for the canary. If we see repeated evictions on same slot, that's our clue.
Jorge: dedupe job started (job id dedupe-multi-1912). preview link: https://redwood.internal/curation/previews/1912345678 (sample 1: 2.0k candidates, 38% Hindi, 25% Arabic, 15% mixed).
Priya: owners: Jorge (dedupe + seedbank), Priya (canaries + eval harness), Abe (kernel traces), Lena (synth + labeling QA), LabelerBot -> queue 300 golden.
LabelerBot: queued 300 golden items; expected completion 2026-03-26.
Jorge: once labeled, will run A/B: fp16 vs qx2b-int4 and produce token-alignment diffs + divergence plots.
Priya: target: run canary by EOW. If labeling delayed, fallback to 50 micro-gold for immediate health check.
Lena: noted. I'll also add a tokenization sanity check to the tokenizer repo to ensure stable encoding across scripts.
Abe: if kernel-level logs point to eviction storm, we may try group-size 64 and a different sharding scheme. escalate to eng-runtime if necessary.
Priya: thanks all, posting this as the canonical thread for this bring-up. will attach diffs and canary IDs when ready.
